pages.text: Three chains of five side by side, joined at both ends by a row of $(item)cable hubs$(). Chains next to each other do not connect through their sides, so the hubs tie them into one bank.
Each chain outputs 60 V and up to 20 A, so the bank delivers three times the current of one chain.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
